title: The Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-29
source: SBD MR@ 7.5 ips>R @ 7.5 ips.(Wilson Boswell).  Transfer info:Akai GX636 > Apogee Mini Me @24/96>Mini DAC(monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One soundcard>Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44 via 'UV22HR' Apogee algorithim > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix with crystal‑clear organ, featuring smoking Saint Stephen and Cumberland jams
ai_review.review: The recording captures a superb 1971 performance highlighted by a blazing Saint Stephen jam after the Alligator/Drums segment and an inspired Cumberland jam. Reviewers rave about the clear organ and overall great mix, though one notes that the Alligator jam isn’t as strong as earlier years.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both musical performance and recording clarity; a single 3‑star review offers mild criticism, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great mix with crystal‑clear organ; reviewers describe the sound as clear and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam after Alligator/Drums transitions into a standout Saint Stephen performance; overall flow is tight with high‑energy peaks.

band_member_comments.Keys: Ron’s organ (keyboard) is described as clear and a highlight of the mix.
